gen-dafont-capture-it-rubik: Capture It towers on its x-height, with nearly sealed letters and terminals as hefty as the stems, all urban and blunt. Rubik, a soft plain sans, sits beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-bespoke-san: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz stacks big-bodied lowercase letters above a sharper, more refined sans. And Capture Smallz earns its keep set big and short, while Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-epunda-slab: Capture Smallz is all big-bodied lowercase, raw and tactical. It grabs attention as display, while the text serif Epunda Slab keeps a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms for the dignified reading.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-fauna-one: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills its lines with big-bodied lowercase letters. Fauna One is the dignified, literary counterweight, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders under the raw heading.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hanuman: Tactical and raw, Capture Smallz piles up big-bodied lowercase that shouts across every line it touches. Hanuman, a traditional serif with high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals, settles beneath.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads classic and editorial, its open-ended curves and larger-than-usual x-height carrying the text with quiet confidence. Capture Smallz is the one that grabs; Kadwa does the patient explaining.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noticia-tex: Under the raw, big-bodied Capture Smallz, the text reads literary and dignified, each curve gets a generous visible entrance. Noticia Text keeps lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. What stands out is the split: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, while the serif's pried-open e keeps its voice sure.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-scope-one: Scope One lets its counters spill into the surrounding space, with stubby ascenders and descenders tucked beside a big x-height. The standout is how refined Scope One feels against raw Capture Smallz.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-slabo-13px: Raw, tactical, big-bodied lowercase: that is Capture Smallz, with bookish Slabo 13px underneath. And across many lines the serif stays dignified, its large open counters keeping its tall letters clear.
